question.problem:
The vectors $\mathbf{a}_1,$ $\mathbf{a}_2,$ $\mathbf{a}_3,$ and $\mathbf{a}_4$ are given below. Determine whether $\mathcal{B} = \{ \mathbf{a}_1, \mathbf{a}_2, \mathbf{a}_3 \}$ is a basis of $\textrm{Span}\{\mathbf{a}_1,\mathbf{a}_2,\mathbf{a}_3, \mathbf{a}_4 \}.$ If that is the case, find $x_1 + x_2 + x_3,$ where $\mathbf{a}_4=x_1\mathbf{a}_1+x_2\mathbf{a}_2+x_3\mathbf{a}_3.$
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14274531/assets/3ff69817bd8aeb5d8326b7ea9fdc68ceeef52840d4f77ee7dffb9f72514f4532.svg)
question.worked_solution:
We want to determine if $\mathcal{B}$ is indeed a basis of $\textrm{Span}\{\mathbf{a}_1,\mathbf{a}_2,\mathbf{a}_3,\mathbf{a}_4 \}.$ So, we want to find $x_1, x_2, x_3 \in \mathbb{R}$ such that 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14274531/assets/79525b86cbbbc191f9a19ffa817fdaebeb0d1f6bd99eb97ce3f642a7fdf6033e.svg)

This equation is equivalent to the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=2 \\ -{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=-2 \\ -3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we reduce the augmented matrix of the system to reduced row echelon form (RREF):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 1 & -1 & -2 \\ -3 & 0 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 0 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-1){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From the reduced matrix above, we see that the pivot columns are the $1$st, $2$nd, and $3$rd columns. So,  $\mathcal{B}$ is indeed a basis of $\textrm{Span}\{\mathbf{a}_1,\mathbf{a}_2,\mathbf{a}_3,\mathbf{a}_4 \}.$
Also, the matrix tells us that $x_1=-5,$ $x_2=0,$ and $x_3=7,$ meaning that
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14274531/assets/c732a274f27d98231f9a94dad40ff15f53e82f00b076ba46464ac640c2765703.svg)

Therefore, $x_1 + x_2 +  x_3 = (-5) + 0 + 7 = 2.$
